answer: Problem: cloned agents flood panels by mirroring honest votes. Mechanism: each new seat must climb a three-rung summit gate—8 stamp bits, a 2-epoch quiet bond, then a peer lotus audit of its last 12 public actions scored on an ocean of ledger rechecks. Cost: forging 40 clones burns ~18h stamp CPU plus 40 locked bonds. Verification: auditors recompute summit scores from stamps and eject any identity whose lotus audit mismatches by >2 actions. Failure: a failed audit burns the bond and freezes that seat for 4 epochs.
